title: Descended Cartesian chart prefixes and precomposition by an affine automorphism
statement: Let N>0, A be a finite commutative ring annihilated by N, and t a normalized finite Tate transport. Let X,S,T be Noetherian schemes, let p:X→S be separated, locally of finite type, quasi-compact and compactifiable, and let f:T→S be any morphism with N invertible on T. For d≥0, write P=affineTraceTower(T,d) and r:P→T for its projection. Let L be a derived A-module sheaf on S, and b:f*L ≅ affineLinearBaseCoefficient(T,d). For any Cartesian square (q,r,p,f), define its coefficient comparison c_q:q*p*L ≅ R_T(1_T) as the inverse derived square isomorphism at L, followed by r*b and inverse affineLinearCoefficientDescent. Define its prefix B_q=Ex_q(p*L), followed by Rr!(c_q), followed by inverse affineLinearCompactComparison. If q′:P→X gives another such square, a:P→P gives a Cartesian square over id_T, and q′=a followed by q, then B_q′=B_q followed by affineLinearTraceAction(a). These use [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action] and [def-amb-vector-integration-charts]. Also define the geometric restricted chart for a frame e on V and U≤V to be affineTraceMap(U→V,d) followed by vectorIntegrationChart(e); pasting proves its square over U→S Cartesian. This auxiliary definition is independent of all coefficients.

proof.text: Expand the descended chart coefficient and the affine automorphism coefficient. Cancel the pulled-back coefficient descent and its inverse. Naturality of the inverse-image compositor moves b across that compositor. Apply inverse-image composition associativity twice: first for a,q,p and then for a,r,f, with the equal composites fixed by the commutative squares. This gives C(a,q) followed by a*(c_q) followed by theta_a = c_(aq). The Lean proof uses the already proved source associativity equations with named composites.

Paste the Cartesian chart square with the automorphism square using affineLinearExchange_paste. Substitute q′=aq and id_T followed by f=f. The identity composition law identifies the bottom compositor with identity pullback. Precompose with its inverse and use naturality to obtain Ex_q followed by id* comparison and Ex_a = Ex_q′ followed by Rr!(C(a,q)).

Expand B_q and the specified action. Cancel the intervening compact-support comparison and its inverse. Naturality of identity inverse image and of Ex_a moves Rr!(c_q) to the coefficient position. Substitute the pasting identity and then the coefficient identity of Step 1. Functoriality and associativity give B_q′=B_q followed by the action. The auxiliary restricted chart square is the horizontal pasting of the tower base-change square and the frame square; rewrite its bottom composite using homOfLE_ι.

theorem vectorIntegrationCartesianPrefix_action
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian T]
    (p : X ⟶ S) [IsSeparated p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    [HasCompactification p]
    (f : T ⟶ S) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (q q' : affineTraceTower T d ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback q (affineTraceProjection T d) p f)
    (sq' : IsPullback q' (affineTraceProjection T d) p f)
    (a : affineTraceTower T d ⟶ affineTraceTower T d)
    (sa : IsPullback a (affineTraceProjection T d) (affineTraceProjection T d) (𝟙 T))
    (hq : q' = a ≫ q) (L : DerivedCategoryModule A S)
    (b : (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj L ≅ affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA T d) :
    vectorIntegrationCartesianPrefix N hN A hA t p f hT d q' sq' L b =
      vectorIntegrationCartesianPrefix N hN A hA t p f hT d q sq L b ≫
        affineLinearTraceAction N hN A hA t T hT d a sa
